## Summary

A switch bit of the precise canonical Beneš network for a padded modular rotation can be computed directly in **O(h²) bit operations and O(h) working bits**, for N=2^h and every 1<=s<=N, 0<=a<s. Claim type: **scoped written proof and arithmetic construction, with finite exact corroboration**. No new κ.

The new endpoint formulas and child closure avoid constructing the permutation, colored graph or whole row ROM. Interior queries follow one child:

```text
c = x mod 2
s' = floor(s/2) + [s odd and c=(a mod 2)]
a' = (floor(a/2) + c(a mod 2)) mod s'
(h,s,a,j,x) -> (h-1,s',a',j-1,floor(x/2))
```

An empty child is identity; the only nontrivial modular reduction is equality with s'. The proof identifies the source's component orientations, so this is the exact deterministic table, including padded-wire switches. At h=5,s=17,j=6 it supplies any one of the 544 offset/address bits without constructing that ROM.
